decision: Exclude the unreferenced obsolete DOS-symbol aggregation header from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file itself contains an ERROR directive stating that DOS and kernel should use DOSSYM instead.
No reference to smdossym.inc appears in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
The active dossym.inc remains in the core tree and was independently reviewed at index 185.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected core build; it does not establish requirements of unrelated historical build configurations.
